TehSadeghiSoo2025RobustID: simultaneous identification is agreement of effects at a common observational law across candidate graphs.

FangSantos2019DirectionalInference provides the general nonregular-inference background; the finite multinomial pushforward is a specialized application.

novelty_flags.label: Related work and Proposition: adjacent-singleton collision
novelty_flags.one_line: FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG Assumption 1 and Section 4 are the direct known-size adjacent-singleton-cycle boundary, not merely acyclic Figure-5 background; inspect the inaccessible TMLR primary before recasting the collision as a strict excluded-regime result.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question: bounded collision
novelty_flags.one_line: Its consumer says only that it “supplies the bounded negative-output subroutine,” with no named published problem, paper, or applied domain establishing why the support theorem matters independently.

soundness_flags.label: Lemma: semantic gluing
soundness_flags.one_line: Uniform identification is defined as one map on the union, and the displayed iff is exactly the set-theoretic gluing of restrictions agreeing on overlaps; make it a definition or retain only a nontrivial constructive consequence.

soundness_flags.label: def:local-id-output / Open-ended Question: overlap normal form
soundness_flags.one_line: phi_G is typed as Omega_G to Delta(A_Y), but the target and terminal circuit are indexed by every intervention value c_x; the local-map type must be Delta(A_Y)^(A_X), or c_x must be explicit throughout.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Proposition: conditional Global-CID
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The formula-or-collision procedure is assumed to receive a certified paired compressor and a certified terminating overlap saturation.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Global-CID is only a conditional composition theorem, not an independently established completeness or elementary-complexity result.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem: smooth-stratum inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Wald inference is restricted to a C1 branch extension with locally stable ambient-simplex covariance rank.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The asserted normal limit and Wald coverage hold only on the stated regular stratum; guard-boundary coverage is supplied separately by the simultaneous region.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The ID algorithm is stated sound and complete for C-DAG macro effects and returns a formula valid for all compatible causal diagrams.
The paper defines simultaneous identification using one observational density compatible with all candidate SA-MPDAGs and gives a sufficient graphical criterion.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.5 and Appendix B following Theorem 6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives an at-most-four-rule normal form between equivalent do-calculus densities within its derivation-graph framework.
The paper constructs finite canonical SCM families for one causal diagram with finite discrete observed domains.
The paper derives influence-function-based estimators for identified effects in hidden-variable DAG models.
The paper develops inference for directionally differentiable transformations and explains why ordinary bootstrap inference can fail at nonregular points.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Verify the TMLR primary Section 4/Figure 5, then position H_star as a precise nonidentification boundary beyond Ferreira--Assaad Assumption 1 rather than describing that work as acyclic background.

Generalize the four-node collision to a nondegenerate parameterized family of known-size cyclic quotients, preserving a positive separation margin under perturbations; this supplies a generic obstruction rather than one arithmetic witness.
Correct phi_G to return the entire intervention-indexed target vector and demote semantic gluing to a definition, reserving a theorem for a genuinely constructive overlap criterion.
Give bounded collision compression an external consumer: for example, a decidability or exact-bound consequence for the Ferreira--Assaad known-size excluded regime, with a cited comparison.

recommended_next_step: Revise the direct Ferreira--Assaad comparison, repair the local-functional type and vacuous gluing lemma, and give bounded collision a named external consequence before advancing.
